records.title: Browser memory surface demo boundary
records.text: another_brain is rehearsing a static browser chat surface that retrieves local evidence packets before drafting.

records.title: Runtime boundary
records.text: The browser path stays static-only with same-origin demo files, no remote retrieval service, no server retrieval, and no external generator call.

records.title: Evidence packet pipeline
records.text: The intended path is input, state packet, local retrieval, evidence packet, local decoder draft, verifier, finalizer, and fallback.

records.title: Demo non-claim
records.text: This fixture does not claim a product model, browser admission, private memory ingestion, or release checkpoint.
